summary: Master creator economy strategy to grow revenue, package offers, and build monetization dashboards. Enrol for practical 5-day training.
lede: Creator economy strategy connects audience insights and content planning with measurable revenue from digital content. For creators, campaign leads, and content professionals, the course covers audience segmentation, revenue model selection, and content-to-offer planning. It also develops skills in pricing digital products, structuring sponsorships and memberships, tracking RPM and conversion, and managing disclosure, copyright, and platform risks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with content, audiences, or creator partnerships and need a more structured monetization approach. It suits operational practitioners, campaign leads, commercial managers, and independent creators who want to strengthen revenue design, reporting, and governance.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, access to your preferred analytics platforms, and a basic understanding of your current content channels. If available, bring recent performance data, sponsor examples, affiliate links, media kits, or product pages so you can work with real artefacts during exercises.
